title: Upload preview
summary: After the person picks a photo, video or file, shows it full size with a caption field and Send. Sending puts the media in the timeline at once with upload progress.

isTooLarge.description: true when the file is over the homeserver upload limit.

description.description: image only: the sender's description of the photo for screen readers (bipe-chat/bipe#501), at most imageDescriptionMaxLength characters (registries/image-descriptions.json).

items.description: What the person picked, at most 10. Each item is sent as its own message.

caption.description: Text to send with the first item.

quality.description: The setting bipe_chats_media_quality: standard resizes photos and videos before upload; high sends them as they are.

replyingTo.description: The reply of the composer (message-reply), carried over.

isPreparing.description: true while photos and videos are resized and thumbnails made.

maxUploadLabel.description: The homeserver limit, formatted, for bipe_app_upload_too_large.

editDescription.effect: Sets the description of that image item, cut at imageDescriptionMaxLength.

remove.effect: Drops one item; the screen closes when none is left.

send.effect: Sends each item as an attachment with its thumbnail and info, the caption on the first item, an image's description in the content field of registries/image-descriptions.json (UploadParameters.extraContentJson; none when blank), as a reply when replyingTo is set, then closes. Off while an item isTooLarge or isPreparing.

cancel.effect: Closes without sending; the composer draft stays.

notes: Sources: the system photo picker (no full gallery permission needed), the camera (bipe_camera_permission_body when denied) and the system file picker. The attachment menu of the composer opens them; that menu is the composer issue.
quality standard: photos at most 2048 px on the long side, JPEG; videos at most 1280 px. high: no change. The row in Conversas e mídia sets it (bipe_chats_media_quality).
Every image and video gets a thumbnail and a blurhash in its info, so timeline-media can show a placeholder at once.
The SDK encrypts the file before upload; the homeserver stores only the encrypted file.
The send queue keeps the upload when the app goes to the background or the network drops; a failure shows the row as failed with bipe_app_upload_failed and the message-actions retry.
Metadata: photos lose location and camera data before upload.

Image descriptions (bipe-chat/bipe#501, default (a) of the issue): each image item has its own optional description field (label bipe_app_upload_description, placeholder bipe_app_upload_description_placeholder, footer bipe_app_upload_description_footer). Videos and files have none. The description travels inside the encrypted event; no model describes photos and nothing leaves the phone.
